description: Converts between a human decimal amount and integer base units without ever rounding: too many decimals is an error. Decimals are never assumed: pass `decimals`, or an `asset` whose decimals are read from the chain (EVM: "native" or an ERC-20 token address, whose decimals() is read live from the chain; Aptos: any asset, with live decimals; an ambiguous symbol such as USDC returns AMBIGUOUS_INPUT with every option).

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453 (Base) or aptos:1; a bare EVM chain id number also works. Chain names like "base" are refused.

name: token_amount_convert
title: Convert token amounts
